title: Two Kinds of Storms
text: Thunderstorms and blizzards are both powerful storms, but they bring very different weather. A thunderstorm forms on a hot, humid day and brings heavy rain, thunder, and flashes of lightning. A blizzard forms in freezing temperatures and buries towns under deep, blowing snow. Thunderstorms usually last less than an hour before the sky clears again. Blizzards can last for a day or longer, trapping people indoors. Both storms can knock down trees and power lines, but only a blizzard leaves behind a thick blanket of snow.
